reason: Only cache_conflict_layout is on the immutable board, so it is the sole experiment ID to rank. It is a concrete, bounded layout change: 272-byte packed-A slices, a 136 KiB allocation, matching consumer strides and rewinds, with the existing traversal and one kernel call retained. That keeps the correctness risk manageable if all offsets and bounds are updated together. Any benefit is unmeasured, and the supplied evidence does not establish a cache bottleneck; test it only against fresh paired controls.
